subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which Feishu bind grammar should OpenClaw support before any candidate PR changes the public `--bind` account syntax?
rationale: The bug is real, but this PR changes a persisted CLI/config surface where account binds, peer binds, and Feishu conversation IDs overlap; the durable grammar should be a maintainer-owned compatibility decision rather than inferred by cleanup automation.

options.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer binding
options.body: Keep existing `<channel>:<account>` behavior and add a documented peer/conversation form or plugin-owned resolver for Feishu conversation IDs.

options.title: Adopt Feishu default-peer semantics
options.body: Accept that `feishu:<value>` now means group peer and require migration/docs for users who used Feishu account IDs.

options.title: Pause this branch for a different candidate
options.body: Leave this PR unmerged and pick a cleaner sibling implementation after syntax review and proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer binding
recommendation.body: Keep existing `<channel>:<account>` behavior and add a documented peer/conversation form or plugin-owned resolver for Feishu conversation IDs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent routing and agents documentation history makes this the best available owner signal for the cross-cutting public CLI grammar decision.
